The album indicates the direction the group will take going forward, with each member deeply involved in the creative process. Available in 'Living Legend Ver.', contents include: Out Box, Dust Jacket, Poster Book (54 pages), Book Band (1ea), Archive Tag (7ea 1set), Photo Card Set (7ea 1set), Envelope, Sticker Pack (2ea 1set), Lyric Booklet (1ea), CD Envelope, and CD.
